 FK Jablonec vs. Brighton - Head-to-head record
 This will be the first competitive meeting between FK Jablonec and Brighton & Hove Albion, so there is no previous head-to-head record to guide the prediction.
 Instead, the teams’ recent performances offer a clearer indication of what to expect. Brighton have been prolific in attack and solid defensively, while Jablonec have struggled for consistency despite an encouraging home record in European competition.
 The visitors will be favourites, but Jablonec’s results at Stadion Strelnice suggest they could still make the contest competitive.

 FK Jablonec - Strong European home form
 Here is a closer look at FK Jablonec’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum, their latest displays, and how they are preparing for this fixture. We will also examine the expected FK Jablonec vs. Brighton line-ups.
 Recent form
 FK Jablonec have made an inconsistent start to their domestic campaign and will be looking to recover from consecutive defeats .
 Their latest result was a 3-2 home loss to Viktoria Plzen, having also suffered a 3-2 defeat away to Freiburg in their Conference League opener. Lubos Kozel’s side have won only two of their last six matches in all competitions, drawing one and losing three.
 However, their home form in Europe offers encouragement: they won all three Conference League qualifying matches without conceding and are unbeaten in their last seven European home games, with five wins and two draws.
 Jablonec will be without long-term absentees Kevin-Prince Milla and Krystof Karban, while Lamin Jawo is a doubt. Martin Cedidla, who has scored four non-penalty goals this season, is expected to feature in defence, with Vakhtang Tchanturishvili and Antonin Rusek among the attacking options.

 Brighton - In unstoppable winning form
 Let’s take a look at Brighton’s current situation. We will analyse their impressive run of form, recent results, and key players for this European fixture.
 Recent form
 Brighton arrive in Czechia after six consecutive victories in all competitions . Their latest performance was particularly impressive, as they beat Crystal Palace 5-0 in the Premier League, strengthening their position among the division’s leading sides.
 The Seagulls have also started their Conference League campaign emphatically, beating Kauno Zalgiris 4-0. They have scored at least three goals in eight matches this season and have kept clean sheets in each of their last six European victories.
 Head coach Fabian Hurzeler may rotate his squad, but Brighton still have plenty of attacking quality. Georginio Rutter, who scored twice against Kauno Zalgiris, is among those expected to feature.
 The visitors will be without Evan Ferguson, Stefanos Tzimas, Kaoru Mitoma, Femi Azeez and Zadok Yohanna. Pascal Struijk, Mats Wieffer and Yankuba Minteh are also expected to miss out.

 Predictions for FK Jablonec vs. Brighton - Seagulls to Fly High

 The Seagulls have also been defensively solid in Europe, not conceding a single goal, and their strong starts could see them leading at half-time . In contrast, FK Jablonec have been inconsistent and are coming off two straight defeats.
 Given the huge gap in form and quality, our main prediction is a  comfortable away win . Brighton should cover the -1.5 Asian Handicap market.
